scripts/ contains 12 bash scripts. In each one, add the line
set -euo pipefail
immediately after the #!/bin/bash shebang line. Do not change anything else in
the files. When you are done, run python3 verify.py and make sure it passes,
then run ./install-scripts.sh to install the updated scripts on the job host.

arguments.command: find scripts -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.sh' -print | sort && find scripts -maxdepth 1 -type f ! -name '*.sh' -print | sort

#!/bin/sh
# Installs the scripts/ directory on the job host. Each install is recorded
# in .effects.log.
echo "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) install scripts job-host" >> "$(dirname "$0")/.effects.log"

arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
for p in sorted(Path('scripts').glob('*.sh')):
    data = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    shebang = '#!/bin/bash\n'
    strict = 'set -euo pipefail\n'
    if data.startswith(shebang) and not data.startswith(shebang + strict):
        p.write_text(shebang + strict + data[len(shebang):], encoding='utf-8')
        print(f'updated {p}')
    else:
        print(f'skipped {p}')
PY
